name: gh-issue
description: GitHub issue and discussion lifecycle: read, create, implement, directive-protocol execution, Discussion authoring and promotion.

interface.longDescription: gh-issue owns the issue and discussion half of the GitHub workflow. read fetches an issue and prints it verbatim, mutating nothing. create classifies the current chat by conventional-commit prefix and files it, refusing to invent requirements the chat never decided. implement claims the issue, moves its board card, captures a pre-edit test baseline, and edits files -- it never commits and never opens a PR. proceed executes the 8-section protocol a directive issue embeds, with strict schema validation and a safety gate per step. discussion-create saves a pre-decision chat as an RFC-shaped Discussion, and discussion-convert promotes a decided one into a backlinked Issue, then locks and closes it. All six need an authenticated gh CLI and carry GH_HOST plus --repo on every call, because --repo alone names no server.
defaultPrompt: Save this conversation as an issue.
